task: Goal24 Checkpoint 2.1 pre-execution security triage (npm + rust)

method.npm_fix_note: No npm audit fix / npm audit fix --force was run (owner instruction; dependency upgrades are separate owner decisions).

critical.title: node-tar: Decompression/parse DoS via unlimited input
critical.installed_version_note: pinned via package.json overrides (tar 7.5.16); advisory 1123940 affects <=7.5.18 so the pinned version is still inside the vulnerable range
critical.runtime_reachability: install/build-time only; tar is used by node-gyp to extract native-module build inputs during npm install. brain-server runtime code does not import tar.
critical.goal24_relevance: none; not on the Goal24 contract/broker/adapter execution path
critical.rationale: Critical advisory fully explained to package/advisory 1123940. Reachability is npm-install-time only, never the Goal24 execution path. Fix requires semver-major sqlite3 upgrade (separate owner decision). Related tar advisories 1123939 (moderate), 1123941 (high), 1123942 (moderate), 1124287 (moderate) share the same path and disposition.

high.title: Address4 decodes leading-zero octets as decimal while resolvers decode them as octal, allowing SSRF and trust-boundary bypass
high.runtime_reachability: MCP/API HTTP surface (rate limiting) of brain-server
high.goal24_relevance: the future broker runs inside brain-server, so the MCP/API surface is adjacent to the Goal24 runtime; not on the contract-validation path of this checkpoint
high.rationale: Patch available without a major bump; must be resolved before Checkpoint 3 introduces local process execution. Related moderate advisories 1118827, 1130723, 1130724 share this disposition.

high.title: Host confusion via backslash authority delimiters / failed IDN canonicalization
high.runtime_reachability: MCP SDK JSON-schema validation (URI parsing) on the MCP/API surface
high.goal24_relevance: adjacent to the Goal24 runtime (same server process); not on the contract-validation path of this checkpoint
high.rationale: Patch available without a major bump; resolve before Checkpoint 3 launch.

high.title: TLS cert validation bypass (SOCKS5), WebSocket DoS, cross-origin request routing (SOCKS5 pool reuse), cross-user disclosure via degenerate private cache directives
high.runtime_reachability: jsdom fetch during HTML ingestion (html-to-md); SOCKS5/proxy features are not exercised by the app
high.goal24_relevance: none directly; ingestion path only, not the Goal24 execution path
high.rationale: jsdom is used for HTML->Markdown ingestion, not for Goal24 broker execution. Patch available; recommend upgrading undici before Checkpoint 3 as hygiene.

high.title: Inherited libvips vulnerabilities CVE-2026-33327, CVE-2026-33328, CVE-2026-35590, CVE-2026-35591
high.fix_path: @xenova/transformers major upgrade (npm reports fix via @xenova/transformers 1.4.2 semver-major)
high.runtime_reachability: image processing for memory capture / embeddings
high.goal24_relevance: none; not on the Goal24 execution path
high.rationale: Image/embedding pipeline only. Fix requires semver-major change to @xenova/transformers; defer to an owner-approved dependency round.

high.title: DoS via exponential-time / unbounded expansion in glob brace patterns
high.dependency_path: archiver@7.0.1 -> archiver-utils -> glob -> minimatch -> brace-expansion (installed 1.1.14 / 2.1.1 / 2.1.2); also eslint dev toolchain
high.runtime_reachability: vault export/backup archiver glob matching; CLI binary of glob is not invoked
high.goal24_relevance: none; not on the Goal24 execution path
high.rationale: Backup/export tooling path with library-only usage (glob CLI command-injection advisory 1109842 also not reachable: the CLI binary is never invoked).

high.title: glob CLI: command injection via -c/--cmd executes matches with shell:true
high.runtime_reachability: CLI binary only; brain-server uses the glob library API, never the glob CLI
high.rationale: Advisory affects the glob command-line executable; library usage is unaffected.

high.title: SheetJS Prototype Pollution and ReDoS
high.fix_path: no upstream npm fix (SheetJS distribution discontinued); replacement library is a separate owner decision
high.runtime_reachability: spreadsheet ingestion via brain-server API (src/api/handlers/ingest.ts); treats user-supplied files as untrusted
high.goal24_relevance: none; not on the Goal24 execution path
high.rationale: No fix exists. Parsing path is brain-server API ingestion, not Goal24 broker execution. Mitigation: treat uploaded spreadsheets as untrusted input; replacement is an owner-approved dependency decision.

brain_server.moderate_and_low_note: hono@4.12.29 (advisories 1130733, 1138771, 1138772, 1138773; patch 4.12.34), @hono/node-server@1.19.14 (1124006; patch 2.0.5), qs@6.15.1 (1119502), body-parser@2.2.2 (1123976), protobufjs@7.6.3 (1123964, override-pinned; full fix via @xenova/transformers major), sqlite3/node-gyp/make-fetch-happen/cacache/http-proxy-agent/@tootallnate/once (build-time chains), onnx-proto/onnxruntime-web (embedding chain), express-rate-limit (via ip-address). hono and @hono/node-server sit on the MCP HTTP surface -> FIX_BEFORE_CHECKPOINT3 (patches available without major bump). Remaining moderate/low are NOT_ON_EXECUTION_PATH or ACCEPTED_TEMPORARY_RISK (build-time / non-Goal24 runtime chains).
brain_server.goal24_path_assessment: Checkpoint 2.1 adds contract + validation modules only (capabilities/skills/execution contracts, json-safe schema, pure validators). None of the audited vulnerable packages are imported by the new Goal24 contract code. The future broker (Checkpoint 3+) runs inside brain-server, so MCP/API-surface advisories (hono, @hono/node-server, ip-address, fast-uri) are FIX_BEFORE_CHECKPOINT3.

critical.title: node-tar: Decompression/parse DoS via unlimited input
critical.runtime_reachability: Expo build/dev toolchain only; not shipped in the mobile app runtime bundle
critical.goal24_relevance: none; mobile-app is not on the Goal24 execution path
critical.rationale: Explained to advisory 1123940; reachability is the Expo toolchain, not the Goal24 path. Fix requires an Expo major upgrade (owner decision).

mobile_app.high_note: 28 high-severity advisories concentrate in the Expo / React Native toolchain (expo 56.x, react-native 0.8x, @expo/*, metro, @react-native-community/cli*, @xmldom/xmldom, image-size, ip, js-yaml, nanoid, postcss, semver, fast-xml-parser). All fixes require semver-major Expo 57 / React Native 0.87 upgrades. Direct axios@1.17.x carries 1123967 (high, proxy inheritance after config cloning) plus nine moderate advisories; fix available (>=1.18.0, not semver-major). expo-router / expo-splash-screen high advisories are toolchain-bundled. None of these are on the Goal24 execution path.
mobile_app.goal24_relevance: none; mobile-app is not part of the Goal24 broker/adapter surface
